title: A brief history of Windows scroll bar shortcuts
title_zh: 回顾 Windows 滚动条快捷键的历史

paragraphs.en: For the first two decades of Windows, the scroll bar control had just a few basic operations. (For expository purposes, let’s assume that the scroll bar is vertical.) There are five mouse targets: The arrows at the ends of the scroll bar scroll by a line. The regions between the thumb and the arrows scroll by a page. And the thumb itself lets you drag the scroll bar to a specific position.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Windows 的头二十年里，滚动条控件只有几个基本操作。 （为了便于说明，假设滚动条是垂直的。）有五个鼠标目标区域：滚动条两端的箭头按行滚动。 滑块与箭头之间的区域按页滚动。 而滑块本身则让你可以把滚动条拖动到特定位置。

sents.en: For the first two decades of Windows, the scroll bar control had just a few basic operations.
sents.zh: 在 Windows 的头二十年里，滚动条控件只有几个基本操作。

sents.en: (For expository purposes, let’s assume that the scroll bar is vertical.) There are five mouse targets: The arrows at the ends of the scroll bar scroll by a line.
sents.zh: （为了便于说明，假设滚动条是垂直的。）有五个鼠标目标区域：滚动条两端的箭头按行滚动。

sents.en: The regions between the thumb and the arrows scroll by a page.
sents.zh: 滑块与箭头之间的区域按页滚动。

sents.en: And the thumb itself lets you drag the scroll bar to a specific position.
sents.zh: 而滑块本身则让你可以把滚动条拖动到特定位置。

paragraphs.en: Windows 7 Windows 2000 added a right-click menu to the scroll bar. This menu gave you four options that matched existing mouse operations, two operations that matched existing keyboard operations, and a new operation.
paragraphs.zh: Windows 7 Windows 2000 在滚动条上添加了右键菜单。 该菜单提供了四个与现有鼠标操作对应的选项、两个与现有键盘操作对应的操作，以及一个新操作。

sents.en: Windows 7 Windows 2000 added a right-click menu to the scroll bar.
sents.zh: Windows 7 Windows 2000 在滚动条上添加了右键菜单。

sents.en: This menu gave you four options that matched existing mouse operations, two operations that matched existing keyboard operations, and a new operation.
sents.zh: 该菜单提供了四个与现有鼠标操作对应的选项、两个与现有键盘操作对应的操作，以及一个新操作。

paragraphs.en: The interesting new one is “Scroll Here”: You can right-click directly on the spot you want to scroll to, and then pick “Scroll Here”. This is much more convenient if you want to scroll a long distance, since you don’t have to grab the scroll bar thumb and then drag it all the way to where you want to go. You can just focus on where you want to go and not where you are coming from.
paragraphs.zh: 有趣的新功能是「滚动到此处」：你可以直接右键点击想要滚动到的位置，然后选择「滚动到此处」。 如果你想滚动很长的距离，这会方便得多，因为你不不必抓住滚动条滑块再一路拖到想去的位置。 你只需关注想去哪里，而不用管现在从哪里出发。

sents.en: The interesting new one is “Scroll Here”: You can right-click directly on the spot you want to scroll to, and then pick “Scroll Here”.
sents.zh: 有趣的新功能是「滚动到此处」：你可以直接右键点击想要滚动到的位置，然后选择「滚动到此处」。

sents.en: This is much more convenient if you want to scroll a long distance, since you don’t have to grab the scroll bar thumb and then drag it all the way to where you want to go.
sents.zh: 如果你想滚动很长的距离，这会方便得多，因为你不不必抓住滚动条滑块再一路拖到想去的位置。

sents.en: You can just focus on where you want to go and not where you are coming from.
sents.zh: 你只需关注想去哪里，而不用管现在从哪里出发。

paragraphs.en: I used this context menu a lot when I needed to jump long distances.
paragraphs.zh: 当我需要跳转很长距离时，我经常使用这个上下文菜单。

paragraphs.en: An even-more-hidden shortcut was added at the same time: Holding Shift while clicking on the scroll bar jumps the thumb directly to the spot where you clicked.
paragraphs.zh: 一个隐藏得更深的快捷方式也在同一时间被加入：按住 Shift 键并点击滚动条时，滑块会直接跳转到你点击的位置。

paragraphs.en: I didn’t know about this shortcut until recently. I had always used my trusty context menu.
paragraphs.zh: 直到最近我才知道这个快捷方式。 我一直用的是我那可靠的右键菜单。

sents.en: I didn’t know about this shortcut until recently.
sents.zh: 直到最近我才知道这个快捷方式。

sents.en: I had always used my trusty context menu.
sents.zh: 我一直用的是我那可靠的右键菜单。

paragraphs.en: Sadly, almost nobody uses Win32 scroll bars any more. Everybody uses frameworks that provide their own custom scroll bars.
paragraphs.zh: 令人遗憾的是，现在几乎没有人还在使用 Win32 滚动条了。 大家都在使用那些提供自定义滚动条的框架。

sents.en: Sadly, almost nobody uses Win32 scroll bars any more.
sents.zh: 令人遗憾的是，现在几乎没有人还在使用 Win32 滚动条了。

sents.en: Everybody uses frameworks that provide their own custom scroll bars.
sents.zh: 大家都在使用那些提供自定义滚动条的框架。

paragraphs.en: Electron and other Web apps use the Chromium scroll bar, which doesn’t implement the context menu, but at least it does implement the Shift +click shortcut.
paragraphs.zh: Electron 和其他 Web 应用使用 Chromium 的滚动条，它没有实现上下文菜单，但至少实现了 Shift + 点击快捷方式。

paragraphs.en: The WPF XAML framework appears to implement both the context menu Shift +click.
paragraphs.zh: WPF XAML 框架似乎同时实现了上下文菜单和 Shift + 点击。

paragraphs.en: The WinUI XAML framework frustratingly has neither the context menu nor the Shift +click shortcut. ( Though at least one person has requested it .)
paragraphs.zh: 令人沮丧的是，WinUI XAML 框架既没有上下文菜单，也没有 Shift+点击快捷方式。 （尽管至少有人请求过这个功能。）

sents.en: The WinUI XAML framework frustratingly has neither the context menu nor the Shift +click shortcut.
sents.zh: 令人沮丧的是，WinUI XAML 框架既没有上下文菜单，也没有 Shift+点击快捷方式。

sents.en: ( Though at least one person has requested it .)
sents.zh: （尽管至少有人请求过这个功能。）

paragraphs.en: The Qt framework has multiple customization points, so it’s really up to each app’s developer. You can enable context menus with SH_ Scroll­Bar_ Context­Menu , you can enable “left-click to jump to a position” with SH_ Scroll­Bar_ Left­Click­Absolute­Position , and you can enable “middle-click to jump to a position” with SH_ Scroll­Bar_ Middle­Click­Absolute­Position .
paragraphs.zh: Qt 框架有多个自定义点，所以这完全取决于每个应用的开发者。 你可以通过 SH_ScrollBar_ContextMenu 启用上下文菜单，通过 SH_ScrollBar_LeftClickAbsolutePosition 启用“左键点击跳转到某一位置”，通过 SH_ScrollBar_MiddleClickAbsolutePosition 启用“中键点击跳转到某一位置”。

sents.en: The Qt framework has multiple customization points, so it’s really up to each app’s developer.
sents.zh: Qt 框架有多个自定义点，所以这完全取决于每个应用的开发者。

sents.en: You can enable context menus with SH_ Scroll­Bar_ Context­Menu , you can enable “left-click to jump to a position” with SH_ Scroll­Bar_ Left­Click­Absolute­Position , and you can enable “middle-click to jump to a position” with SH_ Scroll­Bar_ Middle­Click­Absolute­Position .
sents.zh: 你可以通过 SH_ScrollBar_ContextMenu 启用上下文菜单，通过 SH_ScrollBar_LeftClickAbsolutePosition 启用“左键点击跳转到某一位置”，通过 SH_ScrollBar_MiddleClickAbsolutePosition 启用“中键点击跳转到某一位置”。

paragraphs.en: Great, so by the time I learn about a shortcut for scroll bars ( Shift +click), the ecosystem has fragmented so much that I can’t even rely on it working.
paragraphs.zh: 好极了，等我学会滚动条的一个快捷操作（Shift+点击）时，整个生态已经碎片化到连它能否生效都指望不上了。

paragraphs.en: Raymond has been involved in the evolution of Windows for more than 30 years. In 2003, he began a Web site known as The Old New Thing which has grown in popularity far beyond his wildest imagination, a development which still gives him the heebie-jeebies. The Web site spawned a book, coincidentally also titled The Old New Thing (Addison Wesley 2007). He occasionally appears on the Windows Dev Docs Twitter account to tell stories which convey no useful information.
paragraphs.zh: Raymond 参与Windows的演进已经超过30年。 2003年，他创建了一个名为The Old New Thing的网站，其受欢迎程度远远超出了他的想象，这一发展至今仍让他心有余悸。 该网站衍生出一本书，书名碰巧也叫The Old New Thing（Addison Wesley 2007年出版）。 他偶尔会在Windows Dev Docs的Twitter账号上现身，讲一些没有任何实用价值的故事。

sents.en: Raymond has been involved in the evolution of Windows for more than 30 years.
sents.zh: Raymond 参与Windows的演进已经超过30年。

sents.en: In 2003, he began a Web site known as The Old New Thing which has grown in popularity far beyond his wildest imagination, a development which still gives him the heebie-jeebies.
sents.zh: 2003年，他创建了一个名为The Old New Thing的网站，其受欢迎程度远远超出了他的想象，这一发展至今仍让他心有余悸。

sents.en: The Web site spawned a book, coincidentally also titled The Old New Thing (Addison Wesley 2007).
sents.zh: 该网站衍生出一本书，书名碰巧也叫The Old New Thing（Addison Wesley 2007年出版）。

sents.en: He occasionally appears on the Windows Dev Docs Twitter account to tell stories which convey no useful information.
sents.zh: 他偶尔会在Windows Dev Docs的Twitter账号上现身，讲一些没有任何实用价值的故事。

paragraphs.en: It’s too bad Win32 has an ever diminishing role in Windows (especially if it’s not even due to the officially sanctioned WinUI 3), but also funny how there are those third-party implementations, somehow with intact Shift-Click behavior. I can add that Firefox doesn’t seem to use the standard scrollbar (no context menu), but does also have this shortcut intact!
paragraphs.zh: 遗憾的是，Win32 在 Windows 中的作用日益减弱（尤其考虑到这甚至并非源于官方支持的 WinUI 3），但有趣的是，竟然存在那些第三方实现，而且不知何故还完好地保留了 Shift-Click 行为。 我可以补充一点：Firefox 似乎没有使用标准滚动条（没有右键菜单），但它同样完好地保留了这个快捷键！

sents.en: It’s too bad Win32 has an ever diminishing role in Windows (especially if it’s not even due to the officially sanctioned WinUI 3), but also funny how there are those third-party implementations, somehow with intact Shift-Click behavior.
sents.zh: 遗憾的是，Win32 在 Windows 中的作用日益减弱（尤其考虑到这甚至并非源于官方支持的 WinUI 3），但有趣的是，竟然存在那些第三方实现，而且不知何故还完好地保留了 Shift-Click 行为。

sents.en: I can add that Firefox doesn’t seem to use the standard scrollbar (no context menu), but does also have this shortcut intact!
sents.zh: 我可以补充一点：Firefox 似乎没有使用标准滚动条（没有右键菜单），但它同样完好地保留了这个快捷键！

paragraphs.en: Damn, I have used Windows for 30 years and just learned about the Shift+click… and the context menu*!
paragraphs.zh: 该死，我用 Windows 用了 30 年，才刚知道 Shift+点击……还有右键菜单*！

paragraphs.en: * I just tried it in Windows 11’s Windows Explorer. Does not work on Edge, though.
paragraphs.zh: * 我刚在 Windows 11 的文件资源管理器中试了一下。 不过在 Edge 上不管用。

sents.en: * I just tried it in Windows 11’s Windows Explorer.
sents.zh: * 我刚在 Windows 11 的文件资源管理器中试了一下。

sents.en: Does not work on Edge, though.
sents.zh: 不过在 Edge 上不管用。

paragraphs.en: Have used Windows for over 2 decades and had no idea Shift+click in the scrollbar was a thing – thanks!
paragraphs.zh: 用了二十多年 Windows，居然不知道滚动条上 Shift+点击这个功能——谢谢！
